description: A span with a smaller line-height than its paragraph does not shrink its line: the paragraph keeps its own line height.

children: and more words to wrap onto lines
florui.css: .p { width: 200px; line-height: 40px; background-color: #e8ecff; color: #112233; } .short { line-height: 10px; background-color: #ffe9c9; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chrome 155 on Windows: 11.78% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. With the property ignored the same fixture measures 47.1% and the box is 54.6px short, so it fails.
